user.title: Connect to PatchMon
user.description: Create an API credential with the `host:get` scope in PatchMon. User credentials are optional and enable patch actions. Accounts with two-factor authentication are not currently supported for patch actions.

data_description.url: Base URL of the PatchMon server, for example https://patchmon.example.com.
data_description.api_key: Secret for the scoped integration credential.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only for a trusted server using a self-signed certificate.
data_description.username: A user allowed to start patch runs.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to PatchMon
reauth_confirm.description: The scoped PatchMon API credential is no longer accepted. Enter a current API ID and key with the `host:get` scope.

error.missing_scope: The API credential needs the host:get scope
error.patch_credentials_incomplete: Enter both the PatchMon username and password, or leave both empty
error.two_factor_required: This account requires two-factor authentication and cannot be used for unattended patch actions

abort.already_configured: This PatchMon server is already configured

data.include_packages: Include package details in sensor attributes

data_description.include_packages: Queries package details for every host with pending updates. Disable for large fleets or strict API rate limits.
data_description.host_groups: Optional comma-separated PatchMon group names or UUIDs.
